# Polite Nahid — Notebook

> A public notebook by Polite Nahid — photographer, writer and filmmaker. Photographs, essays, short films and marginalia, kept in chronological order.

The notebook is a working record rather than a portfolio. New entries are added as they're made and organised into four categories: photography (collections and visual sequences), writing (essays and reflections), films (short documentary work) and notes (short observations).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest notebook entries in chronological order.
- [Notebook](/notebook): Full archive with category filters and search.
- [Photography](/photography): Photographic collections and visual stories.
- [Writing](/writing): Essays on photography, attention and craft.
- [Films](/films): Short films and documentary sketches, with production notes.
- [Notes](/notes): Short observations and marginalia.
- [About](/about): Who Polite Nahid is and why the notebook exists.
- [Contact](/contact): Ways to get in touch.

## Optional

- [RSS feed](/rss.xml): Subscribe to new entries.
